create_colmap_database: create a COLMAP SQLite database with all tables using COLMAPDatabase.connect and create_tables
add_camera_to_colmap_db: add a camera with model, width, height, and params to the COLMAP database using add_camera
add_image_to_colmap_db: add an image with name and camera_id to the COLMAP database using add_image
add_keypoints_to_colmap_db: add keypoints as a numpy array to an image in the COLMAP database using add_keypoints
add_matches_to_colmap_db: add feature matches between two images to the COLMAP database using add_matches
